mathematical_interpretation.G: sum_{i<j}|Y_i/D_i-Y_j/D_j| /(n sum_i Y_i/D_i), with G=0 at zero sum
mathematical_interpretation.P: sum_i w_i |Y_i/D_i-1| using original loaded nonnegative w
mathematical_interpretation.F: G + original binary64 lambda * P; search weights never enter the exact layer
mathematical_interpretation.correctness: Only original-verified physical UB/Start is passed. Inclusive F<=own UB and true-G cover retain all potential original-objective improvers. C++ guard restores global greedy lambda/scaling.
mathematical_interpretation.cold_P: cold full original compact matrix matches inherited qualified reference; no user Start/H; per-run original objective and native bound qualified
mathematical_interpretation.dominance_boundary: Keeping base H guarantees initialization U no worse under the original selection rule. Extra work and changed UB/Start/search do not guarantee final U, L, gap, certification or time dominance under one process cap.
mathematical_interpretation.finite_precision: CERT qualification uses the inherited 1e-7 numerical tolerance, not a new exact rational proof. Raw signed last-bit gaps and bounds are retained.
